project_type: React Native / Expo 51 monorepo — two mobile apps + one Express/TypeScript API gateway
build_system: Each app/service is standalone npm. No workspace tooling. Each must be compiled independently.
test_framework: Backend: Jest (npm test in services/api-gateway). Mobile apps: no test runner configured — verification is TypeScript typecheck only.
test_command: cd services/api-gateway && npm run typecheck   |   cd apps/passenger-app && npx tsc --noEmit   |   cd apps/driver-app && npx tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd services/api-gateway && npm run typecheck` — must exit 0. 2. Run `cd apps/passenger-app && npx tsc --noEmit` — must exit 0. 3. Run `cd apps/driver-app && npx tsc --noEmit` — must exit 0. These are the only automated checks available without a device/emulator.
environment_constraints: NO new npm packages may be installed. Use only what is already in each package.json. expo-speech is absent from both apps — voice directions must be a TODO stub. Driver app has NO react-native-maps — NavigationScreen must be map-free (text UI only).
contribution_requirements: TypeScript: 0 errors in every file created or edited. Use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3001/api/v1' for API base in passenger app. Use process.env.ORS_API_KEY ?? '' on the backend. Colors: #1a1a2e (dark bg), #00d46a (green), #ff3b30 (red), #ff9500 (orange). Swahili labels throughout. Bolt-inspired cards: borderRadius 12, dark backgrounds.
key_patterns: Passenger app: screens import from '../components/AnimatedButton', use axios directly, StyleSheet.create at bottom, no separate src/ folder — screens live at apps/passenger-app/screens/. Driver app: screens live at apps/driver-app/src/screens/, use useTheme() + useTranslation() hooks, navigate via useNavigation<StackNavigationProp<HomeStackParamList>>(), API calls via DriverAPI class or direct fetch. Backend: every new route follows the pattern of existing handlers in tracking.ts — try/catch with mock fallback, in-memory Map for fast state, pool.query for persistence.
directory_structure: daladala/ ├── apps/ │   ├── passenger-app/  (screens/ components/ i18n.ts App.tsx — flat, no src/) │   └── driver-app/     (src/App.tsx src/screens/{auth,main,trip,profile}/ src/navigation/ src/contexts/ src/services/api/) └── services/ └── api-gateway/ (src/routes/ src/database/ src/middleware/ dist/)
